title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 5: Nanako Fujisaki
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．５ ～藤崎奈々子～
overview:
On the verge of a breakout!! Here comes Nanako, now making a big splash in commercials and on TV!!

Volume 5 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring Nanako Fujisaki, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, watch short movies, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz about her.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- Movie Hall: short movies
- Mini games: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

ブレイク寸前!! CM、TVで大活躍中の奈々子チャンの登場だ!!
